findings.governingReading: Even if Shirou himself wanted that outcome
findings.explanation: Accepted changes Shirou’s hypothetical desire into assent to Kotomine’s proposal, blurring his admission that part of him was tempted to want it.

findings.highlight: punch at the rails as if shaking off the Command Spell
findings.evidenceJa: 呪縛を振り払うように手すりを殴りつけた
findings.governingReading: He slams the railing as though shaking off an enchantment or binding.
findings.explanation: Command Spell converts the metaphorical hold of Kotomine’s words into the named magical mark, inventing a specific mechanism.

findings.highlight: A hard steel sound echoes through the night.
findings.evidenceJa: きいーん、という音が夜に響く
findings.governingReading: A high metallic ringing resounds through the night.
findings.explanation: Hard steel replaces the audible ringing quality with an unsupported material judgment.

findings.highlight: I made a sword for her, after that night in the ruins
findings.evidenceJa: 心を重ねた後、彼女の為に剣を作り上げた時
findings.governingReading: after their hearts had joined that night in the ruins, when he completed a sword for her
findings.explanation: The English removes the intimate joining of hearts and leaves only chronology before the projected sword.

findings.highlight: decided I didn’t want to lose her
findings.evidenceJa: 失いたくないと願ってしまった
findings.governingReading: found himself wishing that he did not want to lose her
findings.explanation: The English turns an emotionally involuntary wish into a controlled decision.

findings.evidenceJa: それがたまらなくイヤだった
findings.governingReading: That was unbearably hateful to him.
findings.explanation: Just don’t like sharply reduces the intensity of Shirou’s pain at Saber never having time of her own.

findings.governingReading: a tear whose nature or cause he cannot grasp
findings.explanation: Unnoticed changes Shirou’s inability to understand the tear into failure to perceive it falling.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の屈折した心遣い
findings.explanation: The English removes the twisted or indirect form of Rin’s care that Shirou specifically appreciates.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーに対してだった
findings.explanation: Because of Saber makes the motive causal; Rin is distinguishing the person from whom Archer concealed his identity.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂はいつになく積極的に話しかけてくる
findings.governingReading: Rin speaks to him with unusual initiative, revealing an innately big-sisterly impulse to help vulnerable people.
findings.explanation: The English loses both the unusualness of her effort and, later on the page, omits Shirou’s 姉御肌 characterization entirely.

findings.evidenceJa: さっきまでの態度とは一変した穏やかさで
findings.governingReading: with a gentleness wholly unlike her attitude moments before
findings.explanation: The English reports change but omits the gentleness that governs Rin’s sincere “I like you two.”

findings.highlight: I step out of character and wish for it to be sunny tomorrow.
findings.evidenceJa: 明日は晴れますように、なんて、ガラにもない事を口にした
findings.governingReading: Out of character, Shirou says aloud a small wish that tomorrow will be clear.
findings.explanation: The English omits that he voices the wish, weakening the final concrete act after his private emotional resolution.
